name: Scanalyzer Web Front
description: The Scanalyzer user interface — eight screens over one bundle: Scanalyze, Stats, 3D Cloud, FaceBall, Examiner, Extractor, Groups, Rename. Vite/React, with the analyser and cutting DSP compiled to WASM from the crates beside it. The same bundle is the Tauri desktop app's web view, and ?solo=1#/<tab> draws one screen for an APK:OS window instead of the whole tab strip.
